# Reasonable Restrictions

<!-- STEP id="reasonable-restrictions" -->
## Limits Made by Law

Fundamental Rights do have limits. The speaker is free to state his views, but he is not free to threaten families. The Constitution allows **reasonable restrictions**, so a limit must be reasonable and must also follow the procedure established by law.

<!-- STEP id="rights-with-duties" -->
## Your Right and Mine

Rights come with duties. You use your freedom responsibly, and you respect the same rights in other people.

**A limit protects the rights of others. It cannot be made simply because someone in power wishes it.**
